business_summary: Qibu Corporation Limited engages in research and development, production, and sale of footwear, apparel, hats, bags, socks, accessories, toys, and sporting goods under the ABC KIDS brand name in China and internationally. It offers children's shoes, clothing, and accessories; leather and athletic shoes, and sneakers; t-shirts, sweaters, shirts, trousers, skirts, coats, suits, woolen coats, and down jackets; and accessories, such as bags, hats, socks, underwear, and swimwear. The company also sells its products online. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Qibuli Children's Film Co., Ltd. It sells its products through physical stores. Qibu Corporation Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Huzhou, China.
